policies.title: Freshness Guarantee
policies.content: FreshDirect sources directly from farms and producers for maximum freshness. If you're not satisfied with the freshness of any item, we'll replace it or refund your money, no questions asked. Perishable items are inspected daily and rotated to ensure optimal freshness. Produce is delivered fresh multiple times per week. Meat and seafood are cut fresh daily. Check 'best by' dates on all packaged goods.

policies.title: Delivery Policy
policies.content: We offer same-day and next-day delivery throughout the NYC metro area. Standard delivery windows are 2 hours. You can choose your preferred delivery window at checkout. Delivery fee is $6.99 for orders under $60, free for orders $60 and above. Temperature-sensitive items are transported in insulated bags with ice packs. Someone must be present to receive perishable orders.

policies.title: Substitution Policy
policies.content: If an item you ordered is out of stock, FreshDirect will suggest a similar substitution. You can set your substitution preferences in your account: accept similar items, accept same brand only, or no substitutions. Substitutions are always equal or greater value at no extra charge. You can reject any substitution at delivery for a full refund on that item.

policies.title: Return & Refund Policy
policies.content: FreshDirect accepts returns within 24 hours of purchase for non-perishable items with receipt. Perishable items cannot be returned but are covered by our Freshness Guarantee. To request a refund, contact customer service or use the app. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days to the original payment method. Damaged or incorrect items will be refunded or replaced immediately.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: FreshDirect offers same-day and next-day delivery in the NYC metro area. Select a 2-hour delivery window at checkout. Most orders arrive within the selected window.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order amount?
faqs.answer: There's no minimum order. Orders under $40 have a $6.99 delivery fee, orders $40-$59.99 have a $4.99 fee, and orders $60+ get free delivery.

faqs.question: How do I know if something is organic?
faqs.answer: Organic products on FreshDirect are clearly labeled with an 'Organic' badge. You can filter search results by 'Organic Only' to see only certified organic products. Our organic produce meets USDA organic certification standards.

faqs.question: How do you select my produce?
faqs.answer: FreshDirect's trained shoppers select produce with care, checking for ripeness, firmness, and blemishes. You can add notes to specific items (e.g., 'green bananas please' or 'ripe avocados for today'). We never substitute produce without your approval.

faqs.question: What if my item is close to expiration?
faqs.answer: FreshDirect aims to provide items with at least 5 days until expiration for refrigerated goods and 2 weeks for shelf-stable items. If you receive something close to expiration, contact us for a replacement or refund.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: FreshDirect accepts all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Payment is charged when your order is confirmed.

faqs.question: How do substitutions work?
faqs.answer: If an item is unavailable, FreshDirect will suggest a similar product at equal or lesser price. You can accept, reject, or choose 'no substitutions' for specific items. Set your default preference in account settings.

faqs.question: How can I avoid allergens?
faqs.answer: Product pages on FreshDirect list all ingredients and common allergens. Use our allergen filter to exclude products containing specific allergens (nuts, dairy, gluten, etc.). Add allergy notes to your account so shoppers are extra careful.

faqs.question: How do you keep items cold during delivery?
faqs.answer: FreshDirect uses proprietary insulated packaging with gel packs for temperature-sensitive items. Our fleet of refrigerated trucks maintains the cold chain from warehouse to your door.

faqs.question: Should I tip the delivery driver?
faqs.answer: Tipping is optional but appreciated. You can add a tip at checkout or adjust it after delivery on freshdirect.com. 100% of tips go to your delivery driver.
